apps.name: Super Mario Kart
apps.about: Native SNES recompilation. The project release includes its own RecompLauncher setup profile; provide your own USA ROM.

apps.name: Mario Kart 64
apps.about: Native N64 recompilation using N64: Recompiled and RT64. Requires your own supported game dump.

apps.name: Mario Kart: Super Circuit
apps.about: Experimental GBA recompilation with optional 60 FPS, adaptive widescreen and higher internal resolution. Requires your own ROM and BIOS dump.

apps.name: Mario Kart DS
apps.about: Native recompilation of the European Mario Kart DS. Its own launcher handles ROM setup and configuration; Linux and macOS builds are beta.

apps.name: Mario Kart Wii
apps.about: Native PowerPC static recompilation. Current builds support the PAL disc; Windows uses the project's setup program and Linux uses its AppImage.

apps.name: Mario Kart 7
apps.about: Mario Kart 7 Recompiled, including its launcher setup profile, graphics settings, save handling and 3GX plugin support.

apps.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
apps.about: Experimental Windows recompilation with a native launcher, Vulkan runtime, local racing and experimental online play. Requires your own game files and console keys.

apps.name: Mario Kart World
apps.about: Early native recompilation for Windows and Linux. Its own setup screen builds the game locally from your own Switch 2 dump; allow substantial free disk space.
